---
title: Take-away exercise
---

Build classifiers with RandomForestClassifier() and DecisionTreeClassifier() on another dataset, e.g., [breast cancer dataset](https://scikit-learn.org/stable/datasets/toy_dataset.html#breast-cancer-dataset), and evaluate the model.

Steps: 

1. Load the data
2. Prepare the data
3. Fit the model on training set
4. Evaluate the model performance on both training and testing sets
